comments.author: foxyv
comments.story: Controlled burns help prevent wildfires. Regulations make them nearly impossible
comments.why: Rossmann demonstrates officials not knowing the laws
comments.text: I think the most frustrating aspect of California is the capricious interpretation of laws. There isn't a clear way to ensure compliance. Louis Rossmann did a pretty good job demonstrating a similar issue with New York and the LeadsOnline reporting requirements. Often the people responsible for enforcing the laws, don't even know what the laws are and will often err on the side of fining people. [VIDEO]
